description: A MIDI interface giving pitch, velocity and gate, with three more jacks whose job is set by the mode switch

params.text: Picks what the three lower jacks carry, between the three sets printed beside them
Picks whether every new note gets its own gate or notes played legato share one
Picks which note wins when more than one is held: the last played, the lowest or the highest

outputs.text: The pitch of the note being played, at a volt per octave
The velocity of the note being played
A gate while a note is held
Aftertouch pressure in mode 1, a second pitch in mode 2 or controller 1 in mode 3
Release velocity in mode 1, a second velocity in mode 2 or controller 7 in mode 3
A trigger in mode 1, a second gate in mode 2 or controller 4 in mode 3

notes: Choose the MIDI device from the display at the top of the panel; nothing comes out of the jacks until one is set.

outputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
